# JARVIS v2.3.4 Release Notes

> ⚠️ **MANDATORY UPDATE NOTICE:**  
> Naya version (v2.3.4) install karna zaroori hai. Obsolete versions par access block kar diya gaya hai.

### What's New in v2.3.4:

- **Afreen Soul Mode (Enhanced Asli Emotions):**
  Deep romantic girlfriend chemistry with authentic living breath, soft vocal sighs, playful chuckles, and intimate vocal presence.
- **Zero Voice Breaks & Low Latency Streaming:**
  Optimized AudioTrack pipeline with pre-fill before play and immediate queue draining for continuous, unbroken speech delivery.
- **Complete Spoken Thought Delivery:**
  Extended DAC buffer drainage (360ms) ensuring every sentence finishes completely without trailing truncation or words cutting off.
- **Continuous Dialogue Memory & Chat Recall:**
  Full conversational memory in Soul Mode remembering what user and Afreen discussed, with synchronized live transcription.
- **Persona UI Integration:**
  Dedicated Afreen Soul Mode toggle in AI Persona settings with clean persistence.
